commands.command:
cd /root/zram-ansible && cat > zram-swap.yml <<'EOF'
---
- name: Configure compressed zram swap on node1
  hosts: target
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Install systemd-zram-generator
      apt:
        name: systemd-zram-generator
        state: present
        update_cache: true

    - name: Configure zram0 device (512MB, zstd, high priority)
      copy:
        dest: /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf
        content: |
          [zram0]
          zram-size = 512
          compression-algorithm = zstd
          swap-priority = 100
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      register: zram_conf

    - name: Reload systemd unit files after generator config change
      systemd:
        daemon_reload: true
      when: zram_conf.changed

    - name: Lower priority of any disk-backed swap entries in fstab
      replace:
        path: /etc/fstab
        regexp: '^(\S+\s+\S+\s+swap\s+\S*?)(?:,pri=-?\d+)?(\s*)$'
        replace: '\1,pri=-10\2'
      register: fstab_swap
      failed_when: false

    - name: Start the zram swap device now
      systemd:
        name: dev-zram0.swap
        state: started
        enabled: true

    - name: Verify swap is active
      command: swapon --show
      register: swap_show
      changed_when: false

    - name: Show swap status
      debug:
        var: swap_show.stdout_lines
EOF
echo done
commands.stdout: done

    - name: Persist zram module load at boot
      copy:
        dest: /etc/modules-load.d/zram.conf
        content: "zram\n"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"

    - name: Configure zram0 device (512MB, zstd, high priority)
      copy:
        dest: /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf
        content: |
          [zram0]
          zram-size = 512
          compression-algorithm = zstd
          swap-priority = 100
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      register: zram_conf

    - name: Reload systemd unit files after generator config change
      systemd:
        daemon_reload: true

    - name: Lower priority of any disk-backed swap entries in fstab
      replace:
        path: /etc/fstab
        regexp: '^(\S+\s+\S+\s+swap\s+\S*?)(?:,pri=-?\d+)?(\s*)$'
        replace: '\1,pri=-10\2'

    - name: Start the zram swap device now
      systemd:
        name: dev-zram0.swap
        state: started
        enabled: true

    - name: Verify swap is active
      command: swapon --show
      register: swap_show
      changed_when: false

    - name: Show swap status
      debug:
        var: swap_show.stdout_lines
EOF
